prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 26 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1021; do not mention it.)
text:
This summary describes the course of care for a patient presenting with lumbar strain following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes on a roadway. The patient reported immediate onset of low back pain radiating into the right paraspinal region, with stiffness and reduced range of motion on initial examination. Neurological screening showed intact strength, sensation, and reflexes in both lower extremities, and no red-flag findings were identified. Imaging was not indicated at the initial visit given the mechanism and clinical presentation.

Treatment consisted of 26 outpatient visits over the course of care, including manual therapy, graded therapeutic exercise focused on core stabilization and posture, and patient education on activity modification and ergonomic positioning. Pain levels decreased steadily, and functional tolerance for sitting, lifting, and prolonged standing improved over the treatment period. At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-full lumbar range of motion with minimal residual tenderness and was independent with a home exercise program. Residual mild intermittent discomfort with prolonged sitting was noted. Return to usual occupational and recreational activities was documented, with continued self-directed exercise recommended.
